node: Defense subtier supplier base and qualified small manufacturers
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-market universe around the hypothesis that rising defense appropriations or surge-production programs may expose capacity limits below the prime-contractor layer. The strongest underfollowed lane for this pass is not headline primes, but qualified Tier-2/Tier-3 manufacturers in defense electronics, aerostructures, composite/ablative materials, optical systems, and narrow program-qualified components. Candidate inclusion is research-priority only, not a buy/sell view.
